_about: Copy lint for ChoZen Boutique, written for this brand (copy-voice.md). Catches AI tells, hype, borrowed registers, health claims, pressure tactics and unconfirmed facts. Scope 'visible' = page text, title, meta description and image alt text. level: fail | warn.

strip: Crystals are sold as decorative and spiritual items. Their traditional meanings are not scientifically proven and are not a substitute for medical advice or treatment.
Warning: children under 8 years can choke or suffocate on uninflated or broken balloons. Adult supervision is required. Keep uninflated balloons away from children. Discard broken balloons at once.

\bwhether you['’]re\b|\blook no further\b|\bin the heart of\b|\bsomething for everyone\b|\bwe['’]ve got you covered\b|\brest assured\b|\bthat['’]s where we come in\b|\bthe perfect (gift|way|choice) (for|to)\b
aiTells.reason: Stock openers and filler. Start with a real person or a real flower.
Paired em dashes are an AI habit; use commas or a full stop.

hype.reason: Adjectives instead of detail. Say what's in it, how it's wrapped and why she chose it.

Three or more very short sentences in a row (four words or fewer) read as hard-sell, not as her.

pressure.reason: Pressure tactics (DMCC Act, CAP 3). Urgency only as a kind, true reminder.

headings._about: Generic method: headings may be the questions a customer asks, in her words. Approved non-question headings are product and section names.

fail.reason: A search string pasted as a heading.

lede._about: The first one or two sentences answer the page's question, warmly. Not clipped.
